survivors.title: SYNTAX - Clean, Code-Inspired SaaS Logo
informs: impeccable: Masthead brand lockup: a narrow-grand display mark paired with a small tracked mono/sans descriptor, single ink on warm near-black.
design-taste-frontend: Single bone mark + condensed all-caps wordmark + tracked-out monospace-like subline as a tight, instrument-grade brand lockup on dark ground.
ui-ux-pro-max: Masthead brand lockup: a single monochrome condensed-display wordmark + wide-tracked caps subtitle on warm-dark (the typographic lockup, not the fluid swirl mark).
frontend-design: Masthead brand-identity: a single confident geometric mark plus a wide-tracked uppercase display wordmark sitting on dark ground.

survivors.title: Brackets concept
informs: impeccable: Terminal/code-frame live-preview chrome: chrome titlebar with a mono filename tab, line-number gutter, dense monospace body on a dark ground.
design-taste-frontend: Terminal/editor frame anatomy: dark titlebar with brand+filename, line-numbered monospace body, hairline-separated rail - the live-preview frame structure.
ui-ux-pro-max: Terminal-window live-preview frame: window-chrome masthead + filename tab + line-numbered monospace body as one dark coherent frame.
frontend-design: Terminal-preview frame: a dark window chrome with titlebar/brand, a filename tab, and line-numbered monospace body content.

votes.reason: Monochrome bone-on-near-black display wordmark with a small tracked sans descriptor — exactly the dark-ground, single-ink, confident-letterform masthead altitude.
Bone monogram on warm near-black, narrow all-caps wordmark with wide-tracked subline label - exactly the masthead posture and restrained dark brand-identity the PWRL brand needs.
Monochrome bone-white mark on warm charcoal ground with a condensed display wordmark over a wide-tracked caps subtitle - restraint that is instrument-precise and directly on-brand for the masthead.
Refined geometric monogram on warm near-black textured ground with wide-tracked display sublabel - matte, restrained, single-mark-on-dark; reads as an instrument brand, not consumer.

matrix.title: Ovonex Team Logo - Lettermark O for SaaS/AI/Cloud

votes.reason: Blue/green gradient lettermark on navy, glossy SaaS-AI orb — cool palette, gradient-drenched consumer-AI cliché, off-brand for a warm instrument panel.
Bright blue/green gradient SaaS lettermark on glossy navy with a rounded consumer wordmark - off-palette, glossy, and generic; nothing instrument-precise to teach.
Bright cool blue/green gradient lettermark, glossy consumer SaaS gloss and gradient orbs - off-brand even with color set aside; a logo-construction sheet, not an instrument identity.
Glossy gradient orb lettermark - the exact consumer-SaaS/AI gradient-mark cliche the skill warns against; the construction-grid panel cannot rescue the off-brand mark treatment.
Bright orange chrome/liquid finance brand with a rotated label card and numbered 01 eyebrow — loud, playful, decorative, wrong cadence.

Playful brutalist finance mobile card with rotated vertical type and chunky rounded panels - bright orange maximalism, large radii, and consumer toy energy violate the hairline/2px/restraint discipline.
Playful mobile screen with a large rounded orange card on liquid-chrome - large radius, playful, consumer posture; the brutalist '01' does not rescue the overall feel.

Editorial wordmark with a slash-split condensed display logotype and monospace section-numbering ('01') - a distinctive typographic system directly usable for the masthead and numbered heads (keep rests on the type, NOT the liquid-chrome texture).
Light card on a lime-green ground with pastel PRO pills — light, playful, consumer; fails the dark instrument-panel bar despite an embedded code-editor fragment.
Bright white coding-challenge SaaS layout on a green wave background - light, consumer, soft-shadowed cards; only a small embedded editor is dark and it is generic.

A light/consumer white-and-green page rescued only by one dark editor sub-panel; light mode is a separate reject trigger, and its console/Run-Submit toolbar is out of scope for a passive preview frame (id5 covers the dark frame cleanly).
Light-mode airy floating-card composition on a soft gradient backdrop - consumer challenge UI; the embedded code pane is small and generic, the overall structure is light-mode-not-dark-instrument.
Dark code-editor chrome: file-tree rail, dark titlebar with a mono filename tab, line-numbered monospace body on a deep ground — the exact terminal-window affordance.
Dark code-editor chrome with a clean titled header bar, monospace line-numbered body, and crisp file-list rail - directly informs the terminal-window live-preview frame hierarchy.

A coherent fully-dark code-editor window - app-chrome title bar, file-tree gutter, line-numbered monospace body, filename tab - a near-literal terminal-window frame that is restrained and instrument-precise.
Dark IDE window chrome: titlebar with app brand, line-numbered monospace content and a filename tab - exactly the terminal-window live-preview frame pattern, matte and instrument-grade.

matrix.title: Dark Mode Bento Grid UI with Analytics

votes.reason: Dark bento grid but built on glassmorphism, glow, and gradient gauges — glass-as-default and the hero-metric gauge template are impeccable absolute-bans.
Dark but glassmorphic glow-heavy analytics bento with blue spotlight lighting, soft drop shadows, and rounded cards - the lighting/blur/blue-glow language is anti-instrument and off-discipline.
Dark bento grid but built on glassmorphic glow, ambient colored lighting and drop shadows - Almanac forbids drop shadows and large radius; decorative-premium, not hairline-instrument-precise.
Bento cards drowned in lens-flare bloom, soft drop-shadows and rounded-soft corners - decorative glow treatment that violates the 2px-radius/hairline-before-shadow instrument discipline.
Dark admin shell with rainbow metric cards (red/blue/yellow/green/purple) — identical-card-grid plus full-rainbow palette is exactly the SaaS-admin slop the brief rejects.
Dark admin template but a rainbow of saturated stat cards, pink charts, and dense candy-colored chips - multi-color status-by-hue and decorative saturation break the single-amber discipline.

Dark admin template whose hierarchy is carried by saturated rainbow KPI cards - color-as-only-hierarchy survives grayscale as a structural defect (violates visual-hierarchy via size/spacing/contrast, not color).
Generic dark admin template with multicolored chiclet stat cards and a rainbow icon rail - textbook templated admin, no intentional aesthetic point of view.

Same generic Alps dark-admin template as id7 (saturated charts, colored tag chips, generic data table); judged as element=overall it is the shell I reject, and the lone count-strip I'd rescue is itself the banned hero-metric pattern.

Dark admin support board with a clean numeric summary stat-strip, hairline-separated tabular density, and a compact icon rail - genuinely teaches dense status-readout layout and tabular hierarchy on dark ground.

Dark dashboard with a clean hairline-celled summary stat band (label + tabular figure) over a structured data table; its color is decorative chips on an already-structured layout, so the density/figure treatment is the genuine instrument teach.
Dark admin template with multicolor status tags and a dense data table; the numbered summary-stat strip has mild density value but is wrapped in generic-admin treatment that disqualifies it.

matrix.title: Football App - Settings & Alert Preferences UI

votes.reason: On-domain settings screen: grouped section labels over consistent rows of title/subtitle with right-aligned toggle controls — real configurator IA, judged on layout/density with color ignored.

Dark settings screen with grouped, numbered-feeling toggle rows, clear section labels, leading icons, and right-aligned controls - directly models the numbered section-header + configurator-row hierarchy.

Consumer mobile (football) settings list using emoji as structural icons - an explicit ui-ux-pro-max anti-pattern; the weight-based group-header/sub-label hierarchy is generic and the reference itself is off-posture.
Consumer iOS settings list shown as a phone product-mockup (toggle rows, generic settings hierarchy) - consumer mobile genre and mockup framing, not a dense dark instrument panel.
Light lavender/periwinkle productivity dashboard with soft rounded cards — light, pastel, consumer; wrong register entirely for a dark warm instrument panel.
Light lavender/pastel productivity dashboard with soft rounded cards and pale panels - light, soft, consumer; off-tone for a dark warm instrument panel.
Light lavender/periwinkle pastel dashboard with soft rounded cards - light, pastel, consumer-bright; off-brand for a warm near-black instrument panel.
Light pastel-lavender dashboard panels with rounded-soft cards - light-mode consumer SaaS composition, the opposite of a dense dark instrument surface.
